what: Extends the theodb_columnar zone-map skip-pruning consumer (shipped 2026-07-18, int/float/bool) to TEMPORAL columns: timestamp/timestamptz (int64 microseconds -> reuses the I8 skip path) and date (int32 days -> I4). minmax_kind_of maps the temporal OIDs to the integer min/max domain (skip + compute_minmax + extract_zone_predicate + encode_const_bits reuse the proven i64/i32 path unchanged); build_arrow builds naive-tz Arrow Timestamp/Date arrays; build_filter_expr emits an Arrow-typed temporal literal so the DataFusion Filter (final authority, D3) stays type-correct. Measured on a clustered 1M-row monotonic time-series table.
hardware: DigitalOcean c-8 (8 vCPU CPU-Optimized dedicated), PostgreSQL 17.10 + pgrx 0.19.0, shared_buffers=2GB

dataset.clustered_on: ts timestamptz (monotonic, 1-minute steps from 2020-01-01 -> tight per-chunk-group ranges); d = ts::date

reproduce: benchmarks/columnar_zonemap_ts_ab.py (SET theodb.enable_columnar_agg=on; SET theodb.columnar_zonemap_skip on/off; SELECT sum(x) FROM czt WHERE ts BETWEEN <lit> AND <lit> and the same on d date -- ~10%-selective; literal timestamp/date constants so the qual RHS folds to a Const and can be pushed)
goal: byte-identical filtered-aggregate result AND skip path decodes <= 25% of the chunk groups the skip-off baseline decodes, for BOTH the timestamptz and the date column
verdict: GOAL MET for both temporal columns. byte-identical AND skips 88-89/100 chunk groups (decodes 11-12% <= 25% target) for a MEASURED 8.2-8.7x lower latency. Extends the columnar predicate-pushdown advantage to the canonical time-series filter (WHERE ts BETWEEN ...). Reuses the proven I8/I4 skip path; temporal knowledge localized to build_arrow/build_filter_expr + the OID->domain map.
honesty_note: Skip ratio tracks selectivity x clustering. The 8.2-8.7x is on a monotonic ts (the natural time-series case). An unsorted timestamp column prunes little (public-copy.md rule 5).
scope: timestamptz / timestamp / date on the M100 CustomScan aggregate path. Deferred: time/interval, text zone-maps, seqscan path, GROUP BY pushdown, out-of-RAM. arrow_cache (M101 heap path) still declines temporal at encode_cell -- untouched, no regression.
